var supplierid = '';
var notes = '';

var smartCaptureRecId = Json.GetValue("invoice_info_section.8FD8LL9JKM_1");
var fileName = SourceIndexData.GetField("Original_Document_Name");

if (smartCaptureRecId === '---')
{
	supplierid = GetSupplierIdFromRegex(fileName);
}
else
{
	notes += 'else';
	recid = smartCaptureRecId;
}	

notes += "SmartCapture:" + SourceIndexData.GetField("Original_Document_Name");

function GetSupplierIdFromRegex(f)
{
	var r = '';
	var regex = new RegExp(/(\d+)\s/m);	
	var matches = regex.exec(f);
	if (matches !== null)
	{
		r = matches[0]
	}
	return r;
}</InitScript><Filter></Filter><FolderNo>0</FolderNo><IndexingProfileNo>0</IndexingProfileNo><AutoAppendMode>0</AutoAppendMode><ProfileType>16</ProfileType><Assignments><Assignment><FieldNo>-144</FieldNo><CheckCondition></CheckCondition><ErrorFallback></ErrorFallback><Expression>Json.GetValue("invoice_info_section.invoice_id")</Expression><ErrorMode>4</ErrorMode><ErrorEmpty>0</ErrorEmpty><DefId><DefNo>-13</DefNo><IsCase>0</IsCase></DefId></Assignment><Assignment><FieldNo>-197</FieldNo><CheckCondition></CheckCondition><ErrorFallback></ErrorFallback><Expression>supplierid</Expression><ErrorMode>4</ErrorMode><ErrorEmpty>0</ErrorEmpty><DefId><DefNo>-13</DefNo><IsCase>0</IsCase></DefId></Assignment><Assignment><FieldNo>-224</FieldNo><CheckCondition></CheckCondition><ErrorFallback></ErrorFallback><Expression>notes</Expression><ErrorMode>4</ErrorMode><ErrorEmpty>0</ErrorEmpty><DefId><DefNo>-13</DefNo><IsCase>0</IsCase></DefId></Assignment><Assignment><FieldNo>-192</FieldNo><CheckCondition></CheckCondition><ErrorFallback></ErrorFallback><Expression>recid</Expression><ErrorMode>4</ErrorMode><ErrorEmpty>0</ErrorEmpty><DefId><DefNo>-13</DefNo><IsCase>0</IsCase></DefId></Assignment></Assignments><DataExes></DataExes><SourceDefId><DefNo>0</DefNo><IsCase>0</IsCase></SourceDefId><DefId><DefNo>-13</DefNo><IsCase>0</IsCase></DefId><CommonScripts></CommonScripts><ScriptLang>3</ScriptLang></ixprofile>

IMPORTANT PLEASE READ: By signing this document you declare your understanding of the below conditions of entry.

\n\n
    \n
  1. HEALTH and SAFETY: Your safety is important to us. You have a responsibility to care for your own safety and follow all signage and instructions from snack brands personnel.
    2. \n
  2. FOOD SAFETY:  Allergen that is onsite are only Milk and Soy. The site is Gluten Free. Ensure to abide by the GMP policy in the airlock, hair net, lint roller and washing hands before entering the factory. Ensure not to bring any product listed below:
    3. \n
      \n
    • Cereal containing gluten and their products, namely wheat, rye, barley, oats, spelt and their hybridized strains
      • \n
    • Eggs and egg product
      • \n
    • Fish products (including crustacean and related products)
      • \n
    • Milk and milk products
      • \n
    • Peanuts and peanut products
      • \n
    • Soy beans and soya bean products
      • \n
    • Sesame seeds and sesame seed products
      • \n
    • Tree nuts and tree nut related products, except coconut
      • \n
    • Added sulphites in concentration of 10mg/km or more
      • \n
    • Lupin
      • \n
    \n
  3. FOOD SAFETY: As a contractor by signing the below you acknowledge that all tools to be used in the food processing area are to be sanitised prior to commencing work. 
    4. \n
  4. EMERGENCY PROCEDURES: If the evacuation alarm sounds, leave the building by the nearest safe EXIT and follow the wardens (wearing a red hat) directions. Assemble at the area as advised by wardens or SBA Staff.
    5. \n

IMPORTANT PLEASE READ: By signing this document you declare your understanding of the below conditions of entry.

\n\n
    \n
  1. HEALTH and SAFETY: \n
    • Your safety is important to us. You have a responsibility to care for your own safety and follow all signage and instructions from snack brands personnel.
      • \n
    • Drugs and alcohol are prohibited from the site and working under the influence of alcohol or drugs is not permitted at any time.
      • \n
    • Safety boots are required to be worn with the production and warehouse facilities.
      • \n
    • Hearing protection must be worn within production areas.
      • \n
    • If the evacuation alarm sounds, leave the building by the nearest safe EXIT and follow the wardens (wearing a red hat) directions. Assemble at the area as advised by wardens or Snackbrands personnel.
      • \n
    2. \n
  2. TRAFFIC MANAGEMENT:
      3. \n
    • Pedestrian walkways must be used in and around the facility.
      • \n
    • Green zones are for pedestrians only.
      • \n
    • Traffic flow onsite is ONE WAY, and the speed limit is 10km/h.
      • \n
    • Yellow zones are shared zones for pedestrians and vehicles.
      • \n
    • Safety vests must be worn in the Warehouse and grounds.
      • \n
    \n
  3. FOOD SAFETY:  \n
      \n
    • Persons with transmissible or notifiable food illness must not attend the site. If you are unwell, please check with Snackbrands personnel for suitability to work in food production areas.
      • \n
    • Glass and ceramics items such as cups, bottles, containers etc are prohibited from entering the site.
      • \n
    • Allergen permitted onsite are only Milk and Soy. The production facility is Gluten Free. Products containing the below allergens MUST not be taken into the production facility:
      • \n
    \n
      \n
    1. Cereal containing gluten and their products
      2. \n
    2. Eggs and egg product
      3. \n
    3. Fish products (including crustacean)
      4. \n
    4. Peanuts and peanut products
      5. \n
    5. Sesame seeds and sesame seed products
      6. \n
    6. Tree nuts and tree nut related products
      7. \n
    7. Sulphites in concentration of 10mg/km or more
      8. \n
    8. Lupin
      9. \n
    \n
  4. GOOD MANUFACTURING PRACTICES: \n
      \n
    • Protective clothing is required in production areas; laundered or disposable coats, hair covering and long pants.
      • \n
    • Hygiene process must be followed at entry of production areas or between hygienic zones; handwashing, sanitising, and boot cleaning
      • \n
    • Jewellery (including watches, necklaces earrings), false and painted nails are prohibited from production areas.
      • \n
    • Personal items are not permitted in production areas.
      • \n
    • Eating within the production areas is not permitted.
      • \n
    • Product must not be handled or touched at any time.
      • \n
    • All tools to be used in the food processing area are to be clean and sanitised prior to commencing work.
      • \n
    \n
  5. EMERGENCY PROCEDURES: \n
      \n
    • If the evacuation alarm sounds, leave the building by the nearest safe EXIT and follow the wardens (wearing a red hat) directions.
      • \n
    • Assemble at the area as advised by wardens or Snackbrands personnel.
      • \n
    \n
  6. SMOKING/VAVPING: \n
      \n
    • Smoking, vaping or use of e-cigarettes is only permitted in the designated smoking areas.
      • \n
    \n
  7. SECURITY:
    8. \n
      \n
    • Your movements and actions may be recorded on 24-hour CCTV and management may review this footage.
      • \n
    • Photographs or photographic equipment is NOT permitted inside the production or warehouse by contractors or visitors, unless authorized by management.
      • \n
    • All visitors must be escorted.
      • \n
    \n
\nBy signing the below, you are acknowledging and accepting the above site requirements and must abide by these at all times.\n

IMPORTANT PLEASE READ: By signing this document you declare your understanding of the below conditions of entry.

\n\n
    \n
  1. HEALTH and SAFETY: Your safety is important to us. You have a responsibility to care for your own safety and follow all signage and instructions from snack brands personnel.
    2. \n
  2. FOOD SAFETY:  Allergen that is onsite are only Milk and Soy. The site is Gluten Free. Ensure to abide by the GMP policy in the airlock, hair net, lint roller and washing hands before entering the factory. Ensure not to bring any product listed below:
    3. \n
      \n
    • Cereal containing gluten and their products, namely wheat, rye, barley, oats, spelt and their hybridized strains
      • \n
    • Eggs and egg product
      • \n
    • Fish products (including crustacean and related products)
      • \n
    • Milk and milk products
      • \n
    • Peanuts and peanut products
      • \n
    • Soy beans and soya bean products
      • \n
    • Sesame seeds and sesame seed products
      • \n
    • Tree nuts and tree nut related products, except coconut
      • \n
    • Added sulphites in concentration of 10mg/km or more
      • \n
    • Lupin
      • \n
    \n
  3. FOOD SAFETY: As a contractor by signing the below you acknowledge that all tools to be used in the food processing area are to be sanitised prior to commencing work. 
    4. \n
  4. EMERGENCY PROCEDURES: If the evacuation alarm sounds, leave the building by the nearest safe EXIT and follow the wardens (wearing a red hat) directions. Assemble at the area as advised by wardens or SBA Staff.
    5. \n
  5. SMOKING: Smoking is only permitted in the designated smoking areas.
    6. \n

\n\n

    2. \n
  2. FOOD SAFETY: Reporting of infectious or communicable disease is mandatory at this site. If you are unwell or been in close contact to someone with a communicable illness, entry to the production facility is prohibited. Please speak to a SBA representative if unsure.
    3. \n
  3. FOOD SAFETY:  The production facility is Gluten Free. ONLY Allergens permitted in the production areas are Milk and Soy. The following food or foods containing the below are NOT permitted in the production facility;
    4. \n
      \n
    • Cereal containing gluten and their products, namely wheat, rye, barley, oats, spelt and their hybridized strains

      • \n

      • \n
    • Peanuts and peanut products
      • \n

      • \n
    • Tree nuts and tree nut related products
      • \n
    • Sulphites
      • \n
    • Lupin
      • \n
    \n
  4. Food Safety: GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices) rules must be adhered to at all times whilst onsite. The following MUST be actioned prior to entering the production area through the airlock;
    5. \n
\n
    \n
  • Personal items to be removed from pockets and stowed in Office area or lockers
    • \n
  • Dust coat and safety vest to be worn that has been provided by SBA
    • \n
  • Airlock process – Hair net, beard snood (where applicable), lint roller on clothes, wash hands with soap
    • \n
  • Only metal detectable pens allowed
    • \n
\n
    \n
  1. FOOD SAFETY: As a contractor by signing the below you acknowledge that all tools to be used in the food processing area are to be sanitised prior to commencing work.

IMPORTANT PLEASE READ: By signing this document you declare your understanding of the below conditions of entry.

\n\n
    \n
  1. HEALTH and SAFETY: Your safety is important to us. You have a responsibility to care for your own safety and follow all signage and instructions from snack brands personnel.
    2. \n
  2. FOOD SAFETY:  Allergen that is onsite are only Milk and Soy. The site is Gluten Free. Ensure to abide by the GMP policy in the airlock, hair net, lint roller and washing hands before entering the factory. Ensure not to bring any product listed below:
    3. \n
      \n
    • Cereal containing gluten and their products, namely wheat, rye, barley, oats, spelt and their hybridized strains
      • \n
    • Eggs and egg product
      • \n
    • Fish products (including crustacean and related products)
      • \n
    • Milk and milk products
      • \n
    • Peanuts and peanut products
      • \n
    • Soy beans and soya bean products
      • \n
    • Sesame seeds and sesame seed products
      • \n
    • Tree nuts and tree nut related products, except coconut
      • \n
    • Added sulphites in concentration of 10mg/km or more
      • \n
    • Lupin
      • \n
    \n
  3. FOOD SAFETY: As a contractor by signing the below you acknowledge that all tools to be used in the food processing area are to be sanitised prior to commencing work. 
    4. \n
  4. EMERGENCY PROCEDURES: If the evacuation alarm sounds, leave the building by the nearest safe EXIT and follow the wardens (wearing a red hat) directions. Assemble at the area as advised by wardens or SBA Staff.
    5. \n
  5. SMOKING: Smoking is only permitted in the designated smoking areas.
    6. \n

IMPORTANT PLEASE READ: By signing this document you declare your understanding of the below conditions of entry.

\n\n
    \n
  1. HEALTH and SAFETY: Your safety is important to us. You have a responsibility to care for your own safety and follow all signage and instructions from snack brands personnel
    2. \n
  2. FOOD SAFETY: Reporting of infectious or communicable disease is mandatory at this site. If you are unwell or been in close contact to someone with a communicable illness, entry to the production facility is prohibited. Please speak to a SBA representative if unsure.
    3. \n
  3. FOOD SAFETY:  The production facility is Gluten Free. ONLY Allergens permitted in the production areas are Milk and Soy. The following food or foods containing the below are NOT permitted in the production facility;
    4. \n
      \n
    • Cereal containing gluten and their products, namely wheat, rye, barley, oats, spelt and their hybridized strains
      • \n
    • Eggs and egg product
      • \n
    • Fish products (including crustacean and related products)
      • \n
    • Peanuts and peanut products
      • \n
    • Sesame seeds and sesame seed products
      • \n
    • Tree nuts and tree nut related products
      • \n
    • Sulphites
      • \n
    • Lupin
      • \n
    \n
  4. Food Safety: GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices) rules must be adhered to at all times whilst onsite. The following MUST be actioned prior to entering the production area through the airlock;
    5. \n
\n
    \n
  • Personal items to be removed from pockets and stowed in Office area or lockers
    • \n
  • Dust coat and safety vest to be worn that has been provided by SBA
    • \n
  • Airlock process – Hair net, beard snood (where applicable), lint roller on clothes, wash hands with soap
    • \n
  • Only metal detectable pens allowed
    • \n
\n
    \n
  1. FOOD SAFETY: As a contractor by signing the below you acknowledge that all tools to be used in the food processing area are to be sanitised prior to commencing work. 
    2. \n
  2. EMERGENCY PROCEDURES: If the evacuation alarm sounds, leave the building by the nearest safe EXIT and follow the wardens (wearing a red hat) directions. Assemble at the area as advised by wardens or SBA Staff.
    3. \n
  3. SMOKING: Smoking is only permitted in the designated smoking areas.
    4. \n

IMPORTANT PLEASE READ: By signing this document you declare your understanding of the below conditions of entry.

\n\n
    \n
  1. HEALTH and SAFETY: Your safety is important to us. You have a responsibility to care for your own safety and follow all signage and instructions from snack brands personnel.
    2. \n
  2. FOOD SAFETY:  Allergen that is onsite are only Milk and Soy. The site is Gluten Free. Ensure to abide by the GMP policy in the airlock, hair net, lint roller and washing hands before entering the factory. Ensure not to bring any product listed below:
    3. \n
      \n
    • Cereal containing gluten and their products, namely wheat, rye, barley, oats, spelt and their hybridized strains
      • \n
    • Eggs and egg product
      • \n
    • Fish products (including crustacean and related products)
      • \n
    • Milk and milk products
      • \n
    • Peanuts and peanut products
      • \n
    • Soy beans and soya bean products
      • \n
    • Sesame seeds and sesame seed products
      • \n
    • Tree nuts and tree nut related products, except coconut
      • \n
    • Added sulphites in concentration of 10mg/km or more
      • \n
    • Lupin
      • \n
    \n
  3. FOOD SAFETY: As a contractor by signing the below you acknowledge that all tools to be used in the food processing area are to be sanitised prior to commencing work. 
    4. \n
  4. EMERGENCY PROCEDURES: If the evacuation alarm sounds, leave the building by the nearest safe EXIT and follow the wardens (wearing a red hat) directions. Assemble at the area as advised by wardens or SBA Staff.
    5. \n
  5. SMOKING: Smoking is only permitted in the designated smoking areas.
    6. \n

    2. \n

    4. \n

      • \n

      • \n
    • Sulphites
      • \n
    • Lupin
      • \n
    \n
  4. Food Safety: GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices) rules must be adhered to at all times whilst onsite. The following MUST be actioned prior to entering the production area through the airlock;
    5. \n
\n
    \n
  • Personal items to be removed from pockets and stowed in Office area or lockers
    • \n
  • Dust coat and safety vest to be worn that has been provided by SBA
    • \n

    • \n
  • Only metal detectable pens allowed
    • \n
\n
    \n
  1. FOOD SAFETY: As a contractor by signing the below you acknowledge that all tools to be used in the food processing area are to be sanitised prior to commencing work.

IMPORTANT PLEASE READ: By signing this document you declare your understanding of the below conditions of entry.

\n\n
    \n
  1. HEALTH and SAFETY: Your safety is important to us. You have a responsibility to care for your own safety and follow all signage and instructions from snack brands personnel.
    2. \n
  2. FOOD SAFETY:  Allergen that is onsite are only Milk and Soy. The site is Gluten Free. Ensure to abide by the GMP policy in the airlock, hair net, lint roller and washing hands before entering the factory. Ensure not to bring any product listed below:
    3. \n
      \n
    • Cereal containing gluten and their products, namely wheat, rye, barley, oats, spelt and their hybridized strains
      • \n
    • Eggs and egg product
      • \n
    • Fish products (including crustacean and related products)
      • \n
    • Milk and milk products
      • \n
    • Peanuts and peanut products
      • \n
    • Soy beans and soya bean products
      • \n
    • Sesame seeds and sesame seed products
      • \n
    • Tree nuts and tree nut related products, except coconut
      • \n
    • Added sulphites in concentration of 10mg/km or more
      • \n
    • Lupin
      • \n
    \n
  3. FOOD SAFETY: As a contractor by signing the below you acknowledge that all tools to be used in the food processing area are to be sanitised prior to commencing work. 
    4. \n
  4. EMERGENCY PROCEDURES: If the evacuation alarm sounds, leave the building by the nearest safe EXIT and follow the wardens (wearing a red hat) directions. Assemble at the area as advised by wardens or SBA Staff.
    5. \n
  5. SMOKING: Smoking is only permitted in the designated smoking areas.
    6. \n

    2. \n
  2. FOOD SAFETY: Reporting of infectious or communicable disease is mandatory at this site. If you are unwell or been in close contact to someone with a communicable illness, entry to the production facility is prohibited. Please speak to a SBA representative if unsure.
    3. \n
  3. FOOD SAFETY:  The production facility is Gluten Free. ONLY Allergens permitted in the production areas are Milk and Soy. The following food or foods containing the below are NOT permitted in the production facility;
    4. \n
      \n
    • Cereal containing gluten and their products, namely wheat, rye, barley, oats, spelt and their hybridized strains
      • \n
    • Eggs and egg product
      • \n

      • \n
    • Peanuts and peanut products
      • \n
    • Sesame seeds and sesame seed products
      • \n
    • Tree nuts and tree nut related products
      • \n
    • Sulphites
      • \n
    • Lupin
      • \n
    \n
  4. Food Safety: GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices) rules must be adhered to at all times whilst onsite. The following MUST be actioned prior to entering the production area through the airlock;
    5. \n
\n
    \n
  • Personal items to be removed from pockets and stowed in Office area or lockers
    • \n
  • Dust coat and safety vest to be worn that has been provided by SBA
    • \n
  • Airlock process – Hair net, beard snood (where applicable), lint roller on clothes, wash hands with soap
    • \n
  • Only metal detectable pens allowed
    • \n
\n
    \n
  1. FOOD SAFETY: As a contractor by signing the below you acknowledge that all tools to be used in the food processing area are to be sanitised prior to commencing work.

IMPORTANT PLEASE READ: By signing this document you declare your understanding of the below conditions of entry.

\n\n
    \n
  1. HEALTH and SAFETY: Your safety is important to us. You have a responsibility to care for your own safety and follow all signage and instructions from snack brands personnel.
    2. \n
  2. FOOD SAFETY:  Allergen that is onsite are only Milk and Soy. The site is Gluten Free. Ensure to abide by the GMP policy in the airlock, hair net, lint roller and washing hands before entering the factory. Ensure not to bring any product listed below:
    3. \n
      \n
    • Cereal containing gluten and their products, namely wheat, rye, barley, oats, spelt and their hybridized strains
      • \n
    • Eggs and egg product
      • \n
    • Fish products (including crustacean and related products)
      • \n
    • Milk and milk products
      • \n
    • Peanuts and peanut products
      • \n
    • Soy beans and soya bean products
      • \n
    • Sesame seeds and sesame seed products
      • \n
    • Tree nuts and tree nut related products, except coconut
      • \n
    • Added sulphites in concentration of 10mg/km or more
      • \n
    • Lupin
      • \n
    \n
  3. FOOD SAFETY: As a contractor by signing the below you acknowledge that all tools to be used in the food processing area are to be sanitised prior to commencing work. 
    4. \n
  4. EMERGENCY PROCEDURES: If the evacuation alarm sounds, leave the building by the nearest safe EXIT and follow the wardens (wearing a red hat) directions. Assemble at the area as advised by wardens or SBA Staff.
    5. \n
  5. SMOKING: Smoking is only permitted in the designated smoking areas.
    6. \n

    3. \n

    \n

    5. \n
\n
    \n

    • \n

    • \n

    • \n
\n
    \n
